{"id":2055833284,"question_id":4341,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 weeks, 5 days","timestamp":1783176306,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/2055833284/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Valid Pair Sum","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    int maxValidPairSum(vector<int>& nums, int k) {\n        vector<pair<int,int>>vp;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++){\n            vp.push_back({nums[i] , i});\n        }\n\n        long long maxsum = LLONG_MIN;\n        sort(rbegin(vp) , rend(vp));\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i+1<vp.size() ; i++){\n           for(int j = i+1 ; j<vp.size() ; j++){\n               if(abs(vp[i].second - vp[j].second) >= k){\n                   maxsum = max(maxsum , (ll)((ll)vp[i].first + (ll)vp[j].first));\n               }\n           }\n        }\n\n        return maxsum;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-valid-pair-sum","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2294}
